Thread Systems | Senior Backend Engineer | Remote (US) | $170k-$210k | REMOTE

We are looking for an engineer to own our ingestion platform end to end. You will design and operate distributed services in Python and Go, run them on Kubernetes, and keep a heavily loaded Postgres fleet healthy under a sustained write path. The team owns its services in production, including on-call, capacity planning and incident review. We care about correctness under partial failure more than raw throughput. What we look for: strong fundamentals in distributed systems, comfort with AWS primitives, and a track record of shipping services that other teams depend on. Experience with Kafka or gRPC is a plus but not required.
